text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash has been extremely successful in the G1 races at Tokyo Racecourse, and an event is held to celebrate her numerous accomplishments.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She talks about her feelings toward racing. We commemorate our journey with a photo together next to the monument memorializing all her hard work.
